patterns.component_pattern: The app/page.tsx file contains inline component definitions - Navigation, Footer, FeatureCard, etc. are all defined in the same file as functional components.
patterns.navigation_pattern: Current Navigation component uses 'hidden md:flex' for desktop links and shows only a 'Başla' button on mobile. Need to add hamburger menu with slide-out drawer.
patterns.styling_pattern: Uses Tailwind CSS utility classes with dark mode support (dark: prefix). Responsive breakpoints with md: prefix for desktop (768px+).
patterns.link_pattern: Uses Next.js Link component for internal navigation
patterns.icon_pattern: SVG icons defined inline within components

existing_implementations.description: Navigation component exists in app/page.tsx in branch auto-claude/001-ozon-e-menum-net-vibe-coding-v1. Current implementation only shows desktop nav links (hidden on mobile) and a 'Başla' CTA button on mobile.
existing_implementations.current_mobile_behavior: Mobile users only see logo and 'Başla' button, cannot access Features, Pricing, or Login links
